spanish: Así será siempre: la nube lo cubrirá, y aparición de fuego de noche.

findings.issue: תמיד is a singular absolute noun; “siempre” uses it as an adverb without adding a concept.
לילה is an absolute noun with no preposition; “de” is temporal smoothing.

notes: Clause order, 3ms verbs, 3ms suffix, construct appearance-of-fire, and the verbless second phrase match the tokens.
